events.title: Northern Oil Q1 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Down Y/Y
events.body: NOG beats Q1 estimates on strong production, but profit and revenues drop Y/Y as weak gas prices and surging operating expenses weigh on results.

events.title: Imperial Oil Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Rise YoY
events.body: IMO's Q1 earnings miss estimates as weaker upstream income and lower crude prices offset revenue growth, with declines across key segments.

events.title: Expand Energy Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Production
events.body: EXE beats Q1 estimates on strong output and gas prices, tops revenue forecasts and signs a 20-year LNG deal to expand global market reach.
